steps.content: A dense pall of storm clouds smothers the sky, erasing all distinction between night and day. Behind that churning veil, crimson lightning writhes and flickers, poised to lash down at any breath.
Gale-force winds tear around you as you and Yao stand upon the crown of the newly finished tower, your gazes locked on the roiling heavens.
The townsfolk rest safe behind shuttered doors. You have sent word to the watchers on the mountain. One task alone remains: to break this calamity and clear the path home for every waiting family.
Rumble!!!
As if in direct reply to your determination, crimson bolts begin to pour from the clouds. They shatter trees and set them ablaze with fire. They scar the earth with blackened, smoking wounds.
Then a denser barrage comes for you—lightning heavy with Mania, slashing past and caging you in a prison of searing light.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Chief... please lend us your strength!
Yao steps forward without flinching, cutting through the gale and the storm of lightning.
Her hand lifts. From her fingertips, golden light streams forth and gathers, forming a blazing orb of radiance.
The dark shies back from that glow, seizing still for a single heartbeat. Then, in the next breath, a thicker fury of lightning erupts on every side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're not backing down. No matter what!
...Next time, you can just give me the gift directly.
From within that dawn-like fire, a pair of vast wings unfurls with a thunderous rush! They row slowly through the tempest, and the great sweep of air drives back the lightning on all sides.

A cry, pure and clarion, pierces the firmament. Out of the radiance steps a great bird of blazing crimson-orange, launching itself at the black vault of heaven—sunlight made flesh, tearing through the shadow.
And in its wake, an endless stream of colorful ribbons follows, twisting and spiraling into the sky.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Go now! Set the sky ablaze with light!

steps.speaker: Sun Crow
steps.content: Skreeee!

Colorful ribbons swirl in a great gyre around the Sun Crow, spiraling upward at its side. Through the darkness, the prayers woven into those ribbons echo and surge with tremendous strength, carried by Yao's power.
The storm clouds stall in their advance, and the crimson lightning flickers and wanes, as though it has misjudged the depth of human resolve and now shrinks before the weight of their prayers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Drive them back!
Yao channels all her power and joins in perfect resonance with the Sun Crow. The great bird folds its wings in, slow and deliberate, then flings them wide once more.
From its heart, a wave of crimson-orange light blooms outward, hurling the black clouds and red lightning back in surge after surge until they dissolve into nothing.
Above you, unveiled at last, spreads the true night sky, alive with endless stars.
Time holds its breath. Nothing moves but the high, thin ring in your ears, repeating its silent assurance that all of this has truly come to pass.

steps.speaker: Child
steps.content: Mom! Dad! You... you came back!!
A bright, clear child's voice cuts through the stillness of that breath-held moment. The people stir and awaken from their daze. The Sun Crow Goddess has once more stood between them and ruin.

steps.speaker: Townsfolk
steps.content: Thank you! Thank you, Sun Crow Goddess!

steps.speaker: Townsfolk
steps.content: Goddess above, bless you! My boy... my boy's home safe!

steps.speaker: Townsfolk
steps.content: I finished my grasshopper... and my brother came back as he promised! This year... this year we're really all together!
One candle winks into being, then a lantern glows. The town that only heartbeats ago lies drowned in black now blooms with countless points of light.
People spill into the streets, sharing blessings and rejoicing in a New Year found safe and together.
High atop the tower, gazing down upon the sea of lights, Yao releases a shaky breath and sways backward, her strength spent. You rush forward and catch her before she falls.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: It's finished... The little bird's wish... all their wishes... they came true.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've worked hard. You did a great job.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I... I truly didn't do much at all.
Yao opens her hand, and a few soft orange light orbs drift up from her palm like tiny bubbles. Round and plump, they bear an unmistakable resemblance to a certain chubby little bird.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The people... they stood guard at the mountain passes. Held back Mania with their own hands. And those who stayed behind... they offered up everything in their hearts.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: This peace... this warmth... they earned it themselves. Every bit of it.
Yao sweeps her hand through the air, and the little orbs drift swiftly skyward. With a crisp, sharp pop, they shatter into dazzling sprays of fireworks.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: May...
May every storm soften to sweet rain, and may peace find you in every quiet moment.
May... whether within this tale or beyond its pages, joy and abundance follow you, year after year.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: "And thus... the Sun Crow Goddess vanished once more from mortal sight, never again to tread upon this earth."

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: "Yet within the hearts of the people, her memory burned ever bright. Reverence and prayer endure, undimmed by the passing years. For they hold this truth close: so long as faith remains, the world shall know peace eternal."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay, okay, you can stop now. Keep this up, and you're gonna roast the whole Bureau.
Yugu leafs lazily through the pages, reading aloud the final ending in her own unhurried rhythm. Beside her, Yao shifts and fidgets without disguise, her ears blazing a vivid red.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...Just knowing they're safe. That they still believe... that is more than enough.
Yao rises and inclines herself in a deep, grateful bow to Yugu, then makes her way toward the cafeteria.
Evening settles in again, and clusters of people gather over their dinners, their talk already drifting toward the coming holiday.
The little bird has returned to its source, and all the prayers laid upon it fold back into one.
Gazing out at the people, Yao asks you quietly.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Their wishes will come true, won't they?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Whether it's reunion they long for... or freedom.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah. Prayers have power, no question. But what really matters is that they believe they have the strength to make it happen themselves.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just as you believe they'll find happiness, they believe it too... I'm sure of it.

steps.speaker: Black Screen
steps.content: So believe. Believe that in the year to come, happiness will find you, joy will stay with you, and every worry that weighs on you now will let you go.
